description: This file contains PHP functions related to displaying, editing, and managing case updates in the SuiteCRM system. It includes functions for rendering update streams, individual updates, update forms, attachments, and AJAX handling for updates within the case management module.

methods.name: display_updates
methods.description: Renders the update stream for a case, including JavaScript for collapsing/expanding all updates and individual update toggling, as well as associated AJAX functions for submitting new updates.

methods.name: display_update_form
methods.description: Returns HTML for the form used to submit new case updates, utilizing the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: getUpdateDisplayHead
methods.description: Generates the header HTML for a single update, including contact/user info, date, and attached notes.

methods.name: display_single_update
methods.description: Returns the HTML representation of a single case update, formatted based on whether it’s internal, assigned to a user, or linked to a contact.

methods.name: display_case_attachments
methods.description: Provides HTML links to notes attached to a case.

methods.name: quick_edit_case_updates
methods.description: Provides the inline form for adding new updates via AJAX, including necessary permissions and JavaScript code.
